summary: The root وبل (wbl) refers to the extremity of the scapula, specifically the glenoid cavity, and the surrounding flesh or muscle.
lane: وَابِلَةٌ ذ The extremity [ in which is the glenoid cavity ] of the scapula: and the portion of flesh [or muscle ] of the scapula. (IAar, T.) See مَرْدَغَةٌ , and also ضَدَفٌ ; and more particularly اِنْفَرَكَ .
